SPECIFICATION FOR 
STEERING BALL RACES FOR MOPEDS

1. Scope — Covers requirements for steering ball races for mopeds. 

2. Shape and Dimensions — The shape of steering ball races and their critical dimensions shall be 
as recommended in Fig. 1 to 4. Entry chamfers/radii shall be provided as indicated in the figures 
for easy assembly. The radius of the ball track shall be at least 0'15 mm more than the radius of the 
balls used in the assembly. Suitable skirting or any other alternative arrangement to avoid ingress of 
dust shall be provided on the cup-bottom and cone-top. The recommended diameter of pivot tube and 
balls are 25*4 mm and 3*969 mm, respectively.

3. Material — The material used shall be case hardening steel of 15 Cr 65 conforming to IS : 4432-1967 
'Specification for case hardening steels'. Alternatively, the steel used shall have a tensile strength not 
less than 550 MPa ( 55 kgf/mm 2 ) in the core after case hardening. 

4. Genera! Requirements — The steering races shall be smooth and free from burrs. The edges shall 
be rounded off to prevent cuts and nicks. The concentricity of the components shall be as given in 
Fig. 1 to 4. The surface finish of ball track shall be at least 03 Ra. 

5. Hardness — The hardness measured at points case hardened shall be 590-650 XV with a case depth 
of 0*4 to 0*6 mm. 

6. Finish —The ball track of the steering races shall have a smooth finish. The races shall be 
chemically treated against corrosion or zinc plated to service condition number 2 of IS : 1573-1970 
'Specification for electroplated coatings of zinc on iron and steel ( first revision)'. In case of 
zinc plating, hydrogen de-embrittlement shall be ensured after plating. If nickel and chromium plated, 
it shall conform to service grade No. 1 with designation SNi 10b Cr r of IS : 1068-1968 'Specification 
for electroplated coatings of nickel and chromium on iron and steel (first revision ). 

7. Tests — The steering races sha'l be visually examined for any manufacturing defects. A suitable 
load test as agreed to between a purchaser' and the suppliers shall be carried out on each race. At the 
end of the test, the steering race shall show no rupture or tear. 

8. Packing — The steering races shall be wrapped in oil coated paper and packed in cartons. 

9. Marking — Manufacturer's trade name or trade mark may be embossed or punched on components. 
9.1 ISI Certification Marking — Details are available with Indian Standards Institution. 

10. Sampling — Unless otherwise agreed upon between a supplier and purchaser the inspection 
sampling shall be as per IS : 2500 ( Part I )-1973 'Sampling inspection tables : Part I Inspection by 
attributes and by count of defects ( first revision )'.
